steps: Need Z mother of F, F father of W, W wife of L
A: Z mother of B, B father of T, T brother of J so B father of J, J wife of L: fits
B: B is wife of T, breaks chain

check_code:
# chains: (Z mother of X) then X father of Y (Y = wife's father's ... ) check via relation tracing
def rel(opt):
    t=opt.split()
    # tokens: Z op1 B op2 T op3 J op4 L
    ops=[t[1],t[3],t[5],t[7]]
    return ops
def ok(opt):
    o=rel(opt)
    # A model: Z ? B, B x T, T & J, J ! L  => B father of J, J wife of L
    return o==['?','x','&','!']
opts={'A':'Z ? B x T & J ! L','B':'Z ? B ! T & J x L','C':'Z ! B x T ? J & L','D':'Z & B ! T x J ? L'}
res=[k for k,v in opts.items() if ok(v)]
assert res==['A']
